name: Zhou Jia Qi
bio: Zhou Jiaqi is a Chinese actress, born in Jiangsu, China. She made her acting debut in a youth drama called “A river runs through it”.

credits.title: All Quiet at Sunrise
credits.overview: Ma Ke immerses himself in his graduate dissertation on Lucy, the Australopithecus known as “grandmother of mankind”. After his mother inadvertently brings him to a remote house, he seems to discover a pathway to decode human language and regain the essence of love.
